(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

Northrop Grumman develops advanced aerospace and defense systems, including space-based technologies. The company is seeking a Software Engineer at Level 1 or 2 to support the Resource Control team for an operational MILSATCOM payload system by maintaining embedded flight software, developing ground support tools, and contributing across the software lifecycle and on-orbit anomaly investigations.
Embedded flight software engineer developing payload control systems and ground support tools

Responsibilities:
• Help maintain and enhance embedded flight software that controls onboard payload functions, and develop and improve ground support tools
• Contribute across the full software lifecycle—design, implementation, test, integration, and operational support - as well as support on‑orbit anomaly investigations and root cause analysis in collaboration with operations and systems engineering teams
• Collaborate effectively within a multi-disciplinary engineering team

Requirements:
• Bachelor's degree in a STEM discipline with 0 years of experience
• Proficiency in C++ and object-oriented programming principles, with hands-on experience working on production or large-scale laboratory codebases
• Experience developing software on Unix/Linux (coursework or project experience acceptable)
• Active U.S. Government Secret clearance required at the time of application
• Bachelor's degree in a STEM discipline with 2+ years of relevant software engineering experience or a Master's degree in a STEM discipline with 0 years of experience
• Proficiency in C++ and object-oriented programming principles, with hands-on experience working on production or large-scale laboratory codebases
• Experience developing software on Unix/Linux
• Active U.S. Government Secret clearance required at the time of application
• U.S. Citizenship is required for all positions with a government clearance and certain other restricted positions

Preferred:
• Knowledge of Perl, Python, or Java
• Experience with Agile/Scrum processes and the Atlassian suite (Confluence, Jira, Bitbucket, Bamboo)
• Knowledge of real-time operating systems such as VxWorks
• Experience with system simulation environments such as Simics or similar
• Background in software integration, system level testing, and regression testing for medium to large code bases
• Demonstrated curiosity and persistence in investigating complex technical issues and driving them to resolution
